requestedAction: Document registration, activation, dependencies, required capability checks, status projection, and Axis visibility.
rationale: Read each cited registry section against the complete register/registerBatch/applicationStatusReport diff and nearest BackOffice contract. Batch registration now settles every sibling before one captured lease snapshot, refreshes persisted partial state on failure, and preserves both original and refresh errors. Single registrations retain independent refresh. Status composition uses at most four request-local workers while retaining input-relative outcomes. These bounded execution changes preserve the documented distinction between observations, human activation, capability availability and API authorization; they do not add a loader or permit a heartbeat to enable a module. No cited article promises transaction-wide rollback, serial profile reads or per-item snapshot publication.
